description.zh-CN: 电影《牛来》里的小牛犊，出生时站不起来，妈妈喊着"牛来"给了他名字。永远一副看透一切的半睁眼。
description.zh-TW: 電影《牛來》裡的小牛犢，出生時站不起來，媽媽喊著「牛來」給了他名字。永遠一副看透一切的半睜眼。
description.en: The calf from the film Niulai. Too weak to stand at birth, he got his name from his mother calling "Niulai!". Forever wearing a seen-it-all, half-lidded look.

look: golden-ochre calf standing upright like a plush toy, darker amber chest, two dark-brown curved horns, small side ears with pale inner ear, heavy half-closed deadpan eyes with thin arched eyebrows high above, big pale pink-beige muzzle with two nostrils, flat wide mouth line, pudgy pear body, pale pink-beige hoof hands and feet
